svg.title: 01 System architecture & trust boundaries
svg.desc: One website on Replit. Bounded workflow roles share deterministic rules, scoped SQL and optional public vectors.
svg.text: One website on Replit. Bounded workflow roles share deterministic rules, scoped SQL and optional public vectors.
PATHWAY AI | Implemented baseline: main 1878d9e, Growth Map Drops 1–3 | Deployment readiness is checked separately
TRUSTED APPLICATION • Fastify / Node • PORT on 0.0.0.0
Account / ownership / input checks; invitation gate; same-origin browser checks
Consent and persistent AI/search allowance checks before metered tasks
Role-specific context and permissions; not independent database-writing agents
Up to 6 rounds; read tools + propose_actions
Persisted web research and source checks
Explicit student CRUD has its own checks
Read back records → VERIFIED or FAILED
Model cannot approve its own changes
Production PostgreSQL; local SQLite. These are logical partitions in one application database.
Workers: minute polling + hourly letters + explicit advancement; SQL persists state while the host sleeps.
Safe fetch obtains real page text
Buddy can send personal context to the LLM.
Growth uses minimized facts; public Scout excludes
SQL is the program catalog and source of truth.
Pinecone is optional retrieval, not student storage.
No automatic external application, email or calendar edit.
Proposal approval is distinct from direct student forms.
